tasks.dev: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A npm:vite@8.0.16
tasks.tauri: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A npm:@tauri-apps/cli@2.11.5
tasks.build: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno task typecheck && deno run -A npm:vite@8.0.16 build
tasks.typecheck: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A npm:typescript@6.0.3/tsc --noEmit
tasks.lint: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A npm:eslint@9.39.1 . --max-warnings 0
tasks.test:frontend: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A npm:vitest@4.1.7 run
tasks.test:rust: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --locked
tasks.test: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno task test:frontend && deno task test:rust
tasks.format: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A npm:prettier@3.6.2 --write src script .github .release-please-manifest.json *.json *.ts *.mjs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all
tasks.format:check: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A npm:prettier@3.6.2 --check src script .github .release-please-manifest.json *.json *.ts *.mjs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all --check
tasks.check: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A script/check.ts
tasks.generate: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && deno run -A script/generate.ts
tasks.check:rust-style: deno run --allow-read script/check-toolchain.ts && cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked -p poprako-style-check
